description: Prometheus-only fallback for an unvalidated BioETL Ops HTTP datasource. This is an infrastructure notice, not a retention, replay, identity, or run verdict.

panels.description: Static fail-closed notice used when Grafana bootstrap cannot provision BioETL Ops HTTP. UNKNOWN means the HTTP identity backend is absent, not that retention or replay failed.

options.content:
Review Ops HTTP Availability

Ops HTTP not provisioned. Dashboard 2. Pipeline Diagnostics is serving the Prometheus-only notice profile because BioETL Ops HTTP was not validated. Status: UNKNOWN.

No retention, replay, identity, or run verdict can be inferred from this notice. A missing datasource query is not a policy result.

Next action: start the monitoring stack through runtime_manager.py so BIOETL_RUNTIME_SOURCE_ID matches /ops/control-plane/ready, then confirm ops_http=ready, reason=identity_matched, and dashboard_profile=full.
